I will use a CTE to first extract the monthly counts, then another CTE to calculate cumulative sums and YoY growth. Finally, I will select the required columns and filter for the years 2022 and 2023.

args.sql:
WITH monthly_counts AS (
    SELECT
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(insert_date AS DATE)) AS year,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(insert_date AS DATE)) AS month,
        COUNT(city_id) AS monthly_total
    FROM city_legislation.main.cities
    WHERE
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(insert_date AS DATE)) IN (2021, 2022, 2023)
        AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(insert_date AS DATE)) IN (4, 5, 6)
    GROUP BY
        year, month
),
cumulative_and_yoy AS (
    SELECT
        year,
        month,
        monthly_total,
        SUM(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY year) AS cumulative_running_total,
        LAG(monthly_total, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY year) AS previous_year_monthly_total,
        LAG(SUM(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY year), 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY year) AS previous_year_cumulative_total
    FROM monthly_counts
)
SELECT
    year,
    month,
    monthly_total,
    cumulative_running_total,
    (100.0 * (monthly_total - previous_year_monthly_total) / previous_year_monthly_total) AS monthly_yoy_growth,
    (100.0 * (cumulative_running_total - previous_year_cumulative_total) / previous_year_cumulative_total) AS running_total_yoy_growth
FROM cumulative_and_yoy
WHERE
    year IN (2022, 2023)
ORDER BY
    year, month

WITH monthly_counts AS (
    SELECT
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(insert_date AS DATE)) AS year,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(insert_date AS DATE)) AS month,
        COUNT(city_id) AS monthly_total
    FROM city_legislation.main.cities
    WHERE
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(insert_date AS DATE)) IN (2021, 2022, 2023)
        AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(insert_date AS DATE)) IN (4, 5, 6)
    GROUP BY
        year, month
),
cumulative_totals AS (
    SELECT
        year,
        month,
        monthly_total,
        SUM(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY year) AS cumulative_running_total
    FROM monthly_counts
),
yoy_calcs AS (
    SELECT
        year,
        month,
        monthly_total,
        cumulative_running_total,
        LAG(monthly_total, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY year) AS previous_year_monthly_total,
        LAG(cumulative_running_total, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY year) AS previous_year_cumulative_total
    FROM cumulative_totals
)
SELECT
    year,
    month,
    monthly_total,
    cumulative_running_total,
    CASE 
        WHEN previous_year_monthly_total = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE 100.0 * (monthly_total - previous_year_monthly_total) / previous_year_monthly_total
    END AS monthly_yoy_growth,
    CASE 
        WHEN previous_year_cumulative_total = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE 100.0 * (cumulative_running_total - previous_year_cumulative_total) / previous_year_cumulative_total
    END AS running_total_yoy_growth
FROM yoy_calcs
WHERE
    year IN (2022, 2023)
ORDER BY
    year, month
